{{Quote|I don't&hellip;remember.''"<br />''"I have erased that time. We shall never know.|Anakin Skywalker, and the Father|<ref name="GoM">{{TCW|Ghosts of Mortis}}</ref>}}
'''Memory rubbing''' was a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] that allowed an individual to use the Force to alter or erase both the memories and/or learned skills of another.<ref name="GoM" />

The effects of this power could be more or less replicated against a celestial by employing mnemotheraphy via the dark side.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>

==History==
On [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], the [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]] used this power to erase [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] knowledge of his future as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader after he had learned it from the [[Son/Legends|Son]] to tempt him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="GoM" />

On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sold the [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] to [[Zegundis]] while on his way to deliver the infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kenobi then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Memory rub/Legends|erase]] Zegundis's memory of their interaction.<ref name="Lone Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>

On [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], Yoda planned to use this power against the historian [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]], but ultimately decided that to hurt someone like that was not the Jedi way and trusted the man to keep his location secret.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a similar technique while infiltrating a [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex, using it to alter a pair of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers']] memories to forget their presence "for a couple of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]";<ref name="Courtship of Princess Leia">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> he would later repeat this on [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] officer [[Tomathy Manes]] and a [[Duality]] employee on [[Utharis]] to hide any trace of his visit to the military base, albeit reluctantly.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], while undercover, did the same to a [[Blackstar Pirates|Blackstar Pirate]] in order to gain the code for entering the [[Mynock Hole]] on [[Courkrus]].<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] learned this technique from the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] during his five-year journey of Force exploration after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|War]]. He used it twice on [[Ben Skywalker]], once to distort Ben's knowledge of his and [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka's]] newborn child, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], and a second to distort Ben's knowing of the truth that [[Lumiya|Brisha Syo]] was [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] Lumiya.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

[[Cade Skywalker]] tried used this technique on [[Darth Maladi]] during their confrontation at [[Wayland Yuuzhan Vong laboratory|her lab]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to erase her memory of what she'd learned there.<ref name="LEG46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref> The Lady was able to overcome this attack, however, and recovered her full stature and wisdom, if indeed she ever lost it.<ref name="Legacy—War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>
